name: scene3d_add_cameras
description: Add named camera definitions. MAX 7 total — rejects if (current + incoming) > 7. Ids minted as __camera_N__ continuing from existing max N. position and exactly one of target/rotation are required; prefer target. @see guides_get('scene3d')

cameras.description: Cameras to add. Each needs exactly one of target or rotation. Hard limit: 7 total.

focalDistance.description: Focus plane distance in world units. Mutually exclusive with target; use with rotation only for an intentional focus pull.

rotation.description: Quaternion {x,y,z,w}. Use only when target is unavailable.

target.description: Semantic look-at point {x,y,z} in world units. Preferred; server derives rotation and automatic focalDistance, then does not persist target.
